protocol.scope: Both exported held-out models, all sixteen development photos, exact already-prefiltered RGB inputs. Browser executes PNG decoding, NCHW normalization and WASM inference. Full-resolution photograph preprocessing and UI integration are not tested.

requirements: Pin runtime package integrity and the exact exported models.
Compare both probability heads to native ONNX and archived Torch outputs; report all threshold changes.
Verify decoded RGB hashes against the original training inputs.
Close the browser and ephemeral local server even if a check fails.
Do not silently select only successful photographs.
